verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP server lets AI-native users query customer feedback themes, ARR impact, and roadmap data directly via LLMs like ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor, plus Autopilot auto-captures untracked feedback—delivering AI-generated insights and suggestions from Canny's data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of insight quality and no first-party benchmark or case study showing accuracy of generated insights.
